AC1.note: wiki-layer.test.ts 'AC1: emits a page node per page and describes edges'; e2e build produces wiki-pages.jsonl + describes.jsonl; real repo: 50 pages, 373 describes edges

AC2.note: wiki-layer.test.ts 'a graph with no layer files loads with the fields simply absent'; loadGraph omits wikiPages/describes, 231 gdgraph+wiki tests green

AC3.note: wiki-layer.test.ts reverse queries: getPagesDescribing returns both pages for a shared file and nothing else; getFilesDescribedBy covers the forward direction

AC4.note: describes.test.ts 'resolveDescribeSet precedence' — frontmatter replaces, related-code beats key-files, key-files is the fallback

AC5.note: wiki-layer.test.ts 'the module set drives the layer — a stubbed set changes the output'; layer reads validModuleNames, never re-derives grouping

AC6.note: wiki-layer.test.ts 'an unbuilt graph yields an EMPTY layer, not a layer of orphans' — validModules undefined returns {pages:[],describes:[]}

AC8.note: provenance.test.ts upsertFrontmatterField: insert leaves every original line intact and lands inside frontmatter; replace changes no other byte; parse/write round-trip is a no-op

AC9.note: provenance.test.ts 'the SEVENTH file changes the scope' — computeVerifiedScope over the full describe-set, not top-6

AC10.note: wiki-layer.test.ts 'a page describing nothing is undecidable and emits no edges', run against an architecture-type page

AC11.note: wiki-layer-no-git.test.ts: full phase-0 path (build, layer, scope, provenance round-trip) on a tree with no .git; asserts none is created

AC12.note: Measured on the real repo: 1120 files, 2335ms full build, 37ms layer+manifest = 2% ; recorded in journal.md. Full suite 48 fail before and 48 after (worktree at 94998d9a) — zero regressions, +125 passing tests

AC13.note: wiki-layer.test.ts 'nodes.jsonl/edges.jsonl stay byte-identical': build without a wiki, then with one, byte-compare both legacy artifacts

Design corrected during T7: wiki layer must be its own storage files, not new kinds inside nodes.jsonl/edges.jsonl. Five production call sites (wiki/service.ts:365,412; wiki/collect.ts:97; commands/update.ts:869) treat every non-asset node as a source file, so a wiki-page node would be grouped by moduleNameFromProjectPath into a fabricated module and would corrupt validModuleNames — the exact module set wikiPruneOrphans and sac/lifecycle-flag.ts rely on. AC1/AC2/AC7 restated against the layer files and a build manifest; AC13 added to pin the no-regression guarantee
